review_kind.description: What flavor of review this is.
review_kind.title: Review Kind

target_annotation_ids.description: Annotation ids this review targets. Typically one, but continuity reviews carry the same ids as the underlying ContinuityViolationBodyV1.
target_annotation_ids.title: Target Annotation Ids

message.description: Human-readable note shown in the review panel.
message.title: Message

author.description: Coarse author chip — human / agent / system.
author.title: Author

decision.description: Verdict of an ``approval`` review — ``accepted`` / ``rejected``. ``None`` for review kinds that observe rather than rule.
decision.title: Decision

violation_ref.description: Optional id of a ``continuity-violation/v1`` (or other typed payload) backing this review. The FE inspector follows this ref to render rule-specific evidence.
violation_ref.title: Violation Ref

suggested_action_slug.description: Optional acture command slug the FE should highlight as the default action (e.g. 'panel.regen', 'panel.editPrompt').
suggested_action_slug.title: Suggested Action Slug
